name: Cruncharr-Test
description: BLEEDING-EDGE TEST CHANNEL of Cruncharr — tracks the testing branch and updates ahead of the stable release. Expect occasional bugs; use the regular Cruncharr template for the stable channel. Cruncharr is a self-hosted companion for keeping your personal anime media library organized: an *arr-style web interface with catalog and library tracking, a release calendar, activity history, and Sonarr integration. Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64). Set PUID/PGID to match the owner of your appdata and media shares so the container can write to them.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Stores settings, catalog, activity history and logs. Use a separate appdata path from the stable container if you run both.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Where your library files are written and organized.

paths.name: Device Files
paths.description: Optional path for source device files, if your source requires them.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the Cruncharr web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as. Match the owner of your config and media shares.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for new files. 002 creates group-writable files/directories so Sonarr can rename and import them when it shares PGID.

variables.name: API Key (optional)
variables.description: Optional: require this key to access the interface. Leave blank to disable.

variables.name: Account Email (optional)
variables.description: Optional: pre-fill your source account email. Can also be set in the web interface.

variables.name: Account Password (optional)
variables.description: Optional: pre-fill your source account password. Can also be set in the web interface.
